description: This line plot illustrates the average repetition rate of words between generated training samples for each relation category, with the x-axis labeled “Relation Category” and spanning integer values from 0 to 60, and the y-axis labeled “Average Repetition Rate” ranging from 0.0 to 0.6 in linear scale. The plot contains six distinct lines: a solid blue line with circle markers labeled “w/o DPO obo”, an orange line with triangle markers labeled “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”, a green dashed line with triangle markers labeled “DPO”, a light blue dashed line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo”, an orange dashed line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”, and a green dotted line labeled “Average of DPO”. The blue line starts at approximately 0.227 and ends near 0.02; the orange line starts near 0.163 and ends near 0.16; the green line remains mostly steady around 0.117; the light blue average line is mostly flat near 0.163; the orange average line is mostly flat near 0.16; and the green average line is mostly flat near 0.117. All lines exhibit fluctuating trends across the relation categories.
